PRESIDENT'S ORDER 19 OF 1979
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 19 OF 1979
NATIONAL AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (BASIS OF ELECTIONS) (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th October 1979]
No. F. 17 (2)/79-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information:-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order,
1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of 1977) and in exercise of all powers enabling
him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the
National and Provincial Assembles (Basis of Elections) (Second Amendment)
Order, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 5, P. O. No. 14 of 1979.-In the National
and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) Order, 1979 (P. O. No. 14 of
1979), in Article 5, in clause (1), in the explanation, for the words, comma,
figures and brackets, "registered under the Political Parties Act, 1962
(III of 1962)" the words, comma, figures and brackets "which is
eligible under the Political Parties Act. 1962 (III of 1962), to participate in
an election to a seat in a House of Parliament or a Provincial Assembly or to nominate
or put up a candidate at any such election" shall be substituted.
